sources.use: 本文の根拠。直近5試合1勝4敗、11/1〜11/16、後半の得失点差は5試合合計−49点。チームの合計値であり個人成績や1試合の点差ではない。原稿のblob SHAを一致確認。
固定HTMLとあわせ本文の根拠に使用。順位・対戦相手強度の調整済み評価は画像に記載せず、特定試合のプレー再現とも扱わない。
容姿参照のみ。公式写真を目視し、修正時の人物参照に使用。本文や成績の根拠には使用せず、完成画像への写真貼付なし。
目視した承認済み黒×ライム、太い日本語、インクとブラシの作例。旧選手・成績は持ち越さない。
指定outputs側のAは存在せず、既存の制作元にある同名v3を目視確認。今回は黒×ライム案を使用。

person_reference.name: マイク・コッツァー
person_reference.selection_reason: 固定本文の『コッツァー選手が中心、マクガスティ選手はIL』節で中心として扱われ、平均得点・リバウンド・OR・2Pまで説明されているため選択。
person_reference.appearance_checked: 公式写真を目視。短い横分けの茶髪、やや縦長の角張った輪郭、細めの目と眉、まっすぐな鼻、薄い唇、薄い無精ひげ。1回の修正後、髪型と輪郭・目鼻・ひげが公式写真を参照したイラストになっていることを目視確認。
person_reference.depiction: 紺色の無地ユニフォームと黒いアンダーシャツ。両手でボールを保持し身体をひねるプレーのイメージ。実際の試合場面の再現ではない。チームロゴ・リーグロゴ・スポンサー・公式写真の貼付なし。

Approved art direction: deep charcoal black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush strokes, warm off-white Japanese bold typography, energetic hand-drawn ink strokes and crosshatching, sparse high-impact composition. Clearly an illustration, never photorealistic.

Article content exclusively from fixed supplied source.html / source.txt: Yokohama B-Corsairs were 1 win and 4 losses across their most recent five games, November 1–16, 2026. The team's aggregate second-half scoring margin across those FIVE games was minus 49 points. These are TEAM aggregate results, NOT this individual player's plus/minus, and NOT a single game's 49-point margin.

Layout: Left 58% contains exceptionally readable typography with generous safe margins. Right 42% features real professional basketball player MAIK KOTSAR (マイク・コッツァー) in a dynamic three-quarter post-pivot stance, knees bent, torso turning, holding ONE orange basketball securely with two anatomically correct hands near his lower chest, protecting the ball while scanning the court. Crop at thighs only. Keep all of head, both hands, and ball inside the canvas. No other people. Player likeness based on the viewed current official Yokohama B-Corsairs portrait at https://b-corsairs.com/team/players/detail/id=18728?PlayerID=51000394 and official portrait https://b-corsairs.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=1788768680/files/user/team/2026-27/21_KOTSAR.jpg . Depict this real player, not a generic invented basketball player: tall, powerful broad-shouldered Estonian center, light skin; short medium-brown hair neatly side-parted and swept sideways with a slightly raised front, short tidy sides; long somewhat rectangular face with broad angular jaw, wide forehead, straight narrow bridge nose, small light-colored deep-set eyes beneath fairly straight eyebrows, defined ears, thin lips, very light sandy-brown stubble around chin and upper lip, no full beard. Clearly articulate eyes, nose and mouth with ink rather than blacking out the face. Focused natural expression. Simple navy sleeveless basketball jersey over a black short-sleeve undershirt, narrow muted red/off-white trim; absolutely no logos, sponsor marks, team emblems, numbers, or jersey text. Reinterpret the face as a hand-drawn illustration; do not paste a photograph.
